name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when hiring a contractor for a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: When hiring a contractor for a bathroom addition, look for a licensed and insured general contractor with a strong portfolio of similar projects. Verify their experience in your specific area, such as Las Vegas, and check client references and online reviews. Ensure they provide a detailed contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Excellent communication, transparency, and a commitment to quality craftsmanship are also key indicators of a reliable contractor.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a licensed, insured contractor with a strong portfolio, positive reviews, and clear communication. Ensure they provide a detailed contract.
